description: What to switch to when a model is gone or you need a fallback. Ranked by closeness in measured performance, not by vendor or price: what you usually need to preserve first is the quality of the output. Candidates whose context window is less than half the original are excluded. Returns the score, price and context deltas so you can judge; we do not pick for you.
